question:
Select the correctly spelt word and fill the blank.

The Amish community believes in __________ .
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"austerity"** means sternness or severity of manner or attitude; extreme plainness and simplicity of style or appearance. (कठोरता)
 
• **​**The Amish community believes in **"austerity"**, meaning they live a life of simplicity and strictness, avoiding modern technology and luxuries.
 
 
• **Example:** The austerity of the Amish lifestyle is evident in their plain clothing and simple living conditions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **austarity**: This is a misspelling of the word "austerity".
 
• **auasterity**: This is another misspelling of the word "austerity".
 
• **auisterity**: This is yet another misspelling of the word "austerity".
